proofs.text: Read `scripts/hooks/pre-push.sh` and verify it names `purlin_run.py` with `--all --quick` and names no runner of its own. Set up a project with one tagged test through init, run the shim as git runs it and verify exit 0 with `the tagged tests passed`. Break the test and verify exit 0 with `a tagged test failed` and `not blocked`; set `pre_push` to `on` and verify exit 1 with `this push is blocked` and `purlin:test`; set it to `true` and verify exit 1; restore the test with `on` still set and verify exit 0. Write `not json at all` over the config and verify exit 0 with `not blocked`, and verify a passing run prints exactly one `purlin:` line. With `pre_push` still `on`, point the hook at a run script that exits 2, the code for a command line it could not read, and verify exit 0 with `not blocked` and `exited 2`: no test ran, so none failed

rule_text: The hook runs `purlin_run.py --all --quick` and no test runner of its own, and blocks a push only when `pre_push` is `on` and a tagged test failed; every other outcome exits 0 and prints one line saying why

def test_a_failure_with_the_setting_off_is_reported_and_not_blocked(
            self, failing):
        done = failing.push()
        assert done.returncode == 0, done.stdout + done.stderr
        assert 'a tagged test failed' in done.stdout
        assert 'not blocked' in done.stdout
tests.name: test_a_failure_with_the_setting_off_is_reported_and_not_blocked

def test_a_failure_with_the_setting_on_blocks(self, failing):
        failing.setting('on')
        done = failing.push()
        assert done.returncode == 1
        assert 'this push is blocked' in done.stdout
        assert 'purlin:test' in done.stdout

def test_a_run_that_reached_no_test_never_blocks(self, passing):
        """Exit 2 is the run script saying it could not read its command line.

        No test ran, so none failed, and the setting has nothing to act on.
        The hook is pointed at a plugin whose run script is that one answer.
        """
        passing.setting('on')
        stub = os.path.realpath(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='purlin-stub-'))
        try:
            for rel in ('scripts/hooks/pre-push.sh', 'scripts/purlin_python.sh'):
                write(os.path.join(stub, rel), read(os.path.join(ROOT, rel)))
            write(os.path.join(stub, 'scripts/run/purlin_run.py'),
                  'import sys\n\nsys.exit(2)\n')
            done = subprocess.run(
                [SH, os.path.join(stub, 'scripts', 'hooks', 'pre-push.sh')],
                cwd=passing.root, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=300,
                stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL)
            assert done.returncode == 0, done.stdout + done.stderr
            assert 'not blocked' in done.stdout
            assert 'exited 2' in done.stdout
        finally:
            shutil.rmtree(stub, ignore_errors=True)
tests.name: test_a_run_that_reached_no_test_never_blocks
